verdict.rationale: The official 'Building a search application' guide walks through creating a 'books' collection, adding books to it and searching for them. The install guide offers fast local paths such as Docker and Homebrew. Community comments praise the readme and website explanations and describe Typesense as lighter to run than Elasticsearch or OpenSearch in docker compose. Missing for 10: no explicit evidence of the 'within minutes' time-to-first-search claim, and no independent hands-on walkthrough of the quickstart flow.
